I posted the list as a thread reply to your message in #strategic-pod. It has five Vantorre Group tickets, each with its source:

1. #8841: #strategic-pod (Gideon, 2026-07-01) says it was closed. The 2026-05-04 digest says it was open, and the 2026-09-30 digest describes a different site and symptom. The sources disagree, so please check the ticket system.
2. PD-8841: 2026-04-27 digest. It may be the same item as #8841, but the digest doesn't say so.
3. PD-4418: 2025-09-15 digest. I attributed it to Vantorre Group from the cheat sheet, so please confirm.
4. INC-4821: #inc-vtg-hartford (Gideon, 2026-08-03).
5. VT-55120: #inc-vtg-hartford (Gideon, 2026-10-14), the root-cause ticket for the Hartford kiosk outage.

I left out #4812 (Vantorre Mobility) and PD-4402 (Quillfeather). Several digests describe issues without ticket numbers, so the full history may include tickets I couldn't identify. I also did not check the ticket files, which the account folder doesn't list, or search DMs, and I could not verify any ticket against the ticket system itself.
